title: Argus: A Real-EKS Study of When Predicting Spot Interruptions Beats Simple Checkpointing
abstract: arXiv:2609.39067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Spot is 60% to 90% cheaper than On-Demand but can be reclaimed on just a 2-minute notice; for expensive multi-node training this loss can be severe, with one reclaim costing hours of synchronous progress. We build Argus, a Kubernetes operator, and ask empirically, on a CIFAR-10 testbed, when predicting interruptions beats simple checkpointing. Argus on real EKS survives a real Spot drain with a graceful SIGTERM checkpoint, resuming from epoch 8 and losing only the in-progress epoch. Alongside, we further find that in an 80-trial benchmark, the reactive-on-notice degrades toward no protection once interruption outpaces the fixed 2-minute notice, and predictive wasted compute is driven to zero, but with an oversized fixed lead it over-migrates so severely that at the fastest rate only one of five runs completes, while periodic is a strong ML-free baseline. A lead-time sweep turns the lead prediction into a guide

translated_title: Argus：一项真实EKS研究——预测Spot中断何时优于简单的检查点机制
translated_abstract: 弹性计算云（EC2）Spot实例比按需实例便宜60%到90%，但可能在仅提前2分钟通知的情况下被回收；对于昂贵的多节点训练，这种损失可能非常严重，一次回收就可能损失数小时的同步训练进度。我们构建了Argus——一个Kubernetes操作器——并在CIFAR-10测试平台上实证研究何时预测中断优于简单的检查点机制。Argus在真实EKS上通过优雅的SIGTERM检查点机制经受住了真实的Spot驱逐，从第8个epoch恢复，仅丢失正在进行的epoch。此外，我们进一步发现，在80次试验的基准测试中，一旦中断速度快于固定的2分钟通知期，基于通知的响应式防护就会退化为几乎等同无保护的状态；预测方法可以将浪费的计算降至零，但如果使用过大的固定提前量，则会过度迁移，以至于在最快的回收速率下五次运行中仅有一次能完成；而周期性检查点则是一个强大的无需机器学习的基线。提前期扫描将提前期预测转变为一种指导。
tldr: 该论文通过真实EKS实验实证表明，预测Spot实例中断可以优于简单的检查点机制，但只有在合理的提前量下才有效——过大的固定提前量会导致过度迁移，反而严重损害训练完成率。
en_tdlr: Through real EKS experiments, this paper empirically shows that predicting Spot interruptions beats simple checkpointing only with an appropriate lead time, as oversized fixed lead times cause severe over-migration and drastically degrade training completion.
